in_flight_rule: A session is flagged in_flight when its chain_heads.updated_at_ns lies within 86400 seconds before the newest head update in the snapshot (newest_head_updated_at_ns=1787456525691490150, cutoff_ns=1787370125691490048). In-flight sessions are sealed at their head as of the snapshot and may grow afterwards; all other sessions are sealed at their final head.

merkle.leaf_rule: leaf_i = SHA-256(0x00 || session_id || 0x1F || entry_count || 0x1F || head_hash), over the sessions[] array in its listed order (ascending by session_id, compared as UTF-8 bytes). session_id is the UTF-8 bytes of the session id; 0x1F is a single unit-separator byte; entry_count is the decimal ASCII representation with no leading zeros; head_hash is the 64 lowercase-hex ASCII characters of the session head entry hash. No length prefixes.
merkle.node_rule: Level k+1 is built from level k left to right: node = SHA-256(0x01 || left || right) where left and right are the 32 raw digest bytes of adjacent nodes. If a level has an odd number of nodes the last node is promoted unchanged to the next level (no duplication). Repeat until one node remains; the root is its 64 lowercase-hex characters. A single leaf would be the root itself.

residual_disclosure: This seal attests the chain state as of snapshot time (2026-08-23T03:44:46Z) as verified by the K_chain holder. It does not and cannot prove the absence of alteration prior to the seal date. Sessions from the D-1 Ed25519 chain-signing cut-over forward carry independent Ed25519 signatures and do not rely on this attestation; that cut-over had not been deployed as of this snapshot.
sealed_by: Nathan Howard, Third Level IT LLC (operator and K_chain holder)

totals.version_rule: Version is the first byte of the retained observation body (observation/fed_observation types). Entries of other types and entries with no retained body carry no wire version and are counted under v1_entries together with 0x01 bodies.

body_layer.description: Per entry: the retained artifact body (looked up by artifact_id AND artifact_hash) must hash to artifact_hash (base64: bodies hashed after strict decode, literal bodies as stored). Unverifiable (counted, never failed): no retained body, body stored truncated at >= 8191 bytes, or INDIRECT types. Observation bodies whose first byte is 0x02 (v2) carry a session-key HMAC whose key was zeroised at session close; they are unverifiable at rest by anyone, including the operator, and are listed here.

verification.chain_key_id_scheme: sha256-raw-16 applied to the symmetric K_chain: hex(SHA-256(32 secret key bytes)[0:16]). This is a truncation of the daemon's hmac-key-fingerprint/1 (hex(SHA-256(secret))). It is a correlation tag for the key that produced the verified HMACs, not a public key identifier, and reveals nothing about the key.

chain_layer.description: Per entry: canonical JSON rebuilt exactly as the daemon builds it; SHA-256 must equal chain_entry_hash; previous_entry_hash must equal the prior entry's hash (sequence 0: SHA-256('VIRP_CHAIN_GENESIS:'+session_id)); sequences contiguous from 0; HMAC-SHA256(K_chain, canonical) must equal chain_hmac. Per session: chain_heads row HMAC verified and head must equal the last verified entry. Applied to every entry including the six v2-body entries.

verification.fixtures: Before touching the snapshot the verifier reproduced the five Appendix A golden entries, the head row and the milestone row of OPEN-ITEMS-ADJUDICATION.md byte-for-byte (canonical bytes, entry hashes, HMACs): 58/58 checks.
